39441afeca.why: The interleaving, saturated multiply-adds, rounding, packing, store, and flag-producing index update are already direct SSSE3 operations with all temporaries live.

03e4ccbe24.why: Both zeroed vector registers and the copied, shifted rdx value are required, including the shift's ZF, so none of the four instructions can be removed.

82de407999.why: The loaded xmm1 and both interleaved results must survive, so the SSE2 copy and shuffle sequence, stores, pointer updates, and final comparison are all needed.

7c37b84b1c.why: Each of the four required vector results needs a load, sign-bit XOR, and store, followed by the live pointer update and comparison.

64313c1d47.why: The load and r9d shift are required, and sign-extending ecx before decrementing rcx cannot be combined into a single baseline instruction for arbitrary inputs.

8f530bd050.why: Each instruction computes a different required output, so the six updates have no removable intermediate.

38250ddbf0.why: The five instructions independently establish five required final register values and contain no redundant intermediate.

ba9c213c36.why: SSE2 needs separate operations for the two distinct shuffles while preserving xmm0, and the XOR, stores, and pointer updates are all required.
